subject.title: refactor(ui): inline stroke attributes via shared strokeIcon shell

question: Should the shared icon shell replace reliance on global icon CSS after a maintainer confirms representative Control UI rendering on the current head?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes default SVG presentation across the shared icon catalog; the protected maintainer review state means a human should accept that broad visual boundary rather than automation doing so.
